name: Elena Rostova
psychographics: Prioritizes work-life balance over career climbing; values sustainable choices but will pay for convenience to protect her limited free time.
current_solutions: Uses Hellofresh for 2 dinners a week and orders groceries via Gorillas for quick top-ups. She also has a Blue Aprk subscription she rarely uses.
frustration: Tried to order a specific specialty cheese from a gourmet app at 2:15 PM on a Tuesday; the delivery ETA kept jumping from 45 to 90 minutes, and it arrived at 8 PM, completely cold.
decision_style: Compares two options quickly on Instagram, reads 3 reviews, and buys. Will switch brands if a competitor offers faster delivery.
voice: Fast-paced, slightly breathless, mixes English loanwords with German. Uses phrases like 'Echt jetzt?' and 'Ich hab keine Zeit dafür.'
